text_block_list.text: "One day in February, as I headed to the Trainer's Room as usual..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"You're finally here.
Kept me waiting."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Come on, start eating already.
Otherwise, we won't finish in time.

I look where Narita Brian is pointing.
And there, we find...
choice_data_list: That's an incredible amount of chocolate...
That's an insane amount of chocolate...!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Giving me chocolate is fine and all,
but I wish everyone would spread it out a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Let's consume the perishable items
and those nearing expiration first.
choice_data_list: Wait, wasn't this chocolate given to you...?
Wait, wasn't this chocolate given to you...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch, don't think I'll let you be the only one
to dodge your duties.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Look at the card attached to the chocolates.
Prompted by Narita Brian, I look at the message card attached to the chocolate wrapping.

text_block_list.name: Message Card
text_block_list.text:
“Brian-san has always been our role model!
Even the profile of her face while running is so wonderful!”

text_block_list.name: Message Card
text_block_list.text:
"I have nothing but gratitude for the Trainer who has always supported Brian-san.
Seriously, the best... What a wonderful duo..."

text_block_list.name: Message Card
text_block_list.text:
"These chocolates are a token of my gratitude to the two of you.
Please enjoy them."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This chocolate is for you and me.
choice_data_list: Could it be... all of them?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Now then, are you prepared?

And so, I ended up doing nothing
but eating a mountain of chocolates...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haaah. Don't tell me I have to eat
chocolate again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I can't just brush it aside.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Both Mom and my sis are on my case.
Telling me not to waste the goodwill people have given me."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...And with that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"This isn't meant for two—
it's chocolate made just for you."

Opening the package revealed three small chocolates
of the kind commonly seen at convenience stores.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Eat every last bite.

Narita Brian headed back to the dorms,
looking somewhat embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Eat every last bite.
choice_data_list: Do you want something in return?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I don't need it. That's not why I gave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you're offering, I'll gladly accept.
Like I said before, that's just my policy.
choice_data_list: I'll pour all my feelings into it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh... You, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"It's gonna end up so rich it'll give ya heartburn.
Not even the sweetness of sweets could hide that."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I highly doubt anyone else could actually eat this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...At least make it to my taste next time.
Later on, I gave Narita Brian some return treats.
